about: Every external data source and service MapUnite uses: its licence, attribution, whether commercial use is allowed, how it's accessed, and the legal review status. test/server/data-sources.test.mjs fails if code calls a host that isn't listed here. Nothing below is legal advice: every entry is 'pending' until someone qualified has checked the current terms. 'unclear' means we haven't confirmed it: treat as not cleared for commercial use.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap data (via Nominatim, Overpass, OSRM, road extracts)
sources.use: place search, POIs and speed limits (Overpass), the road index for hazard merging (data/roads)
sources.access_method: public APIs at request time; offline extract for data/roads
sources.notes: Data is commercially usable with attribution; share-alike applies to derivative databases. Review before selling an API or publishing a database built on it (derivative vs collective database). The public Nominatim and Overpass servers have usage policies (Nominatim: max 1 request/s, no bulk): self-host for production.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap standard tiles
sources.licence: ODbL (data) / CC BY-SA 2.0 (cartography, check current terms)
sources.notes: The OSMF tile usage policy does not allow heavy production use of tile.openstreetmap.org: move to self-hosted or a commercial tile provider before launch.

sources.name: OSRM demo server
sources.licence: OSRM software BSD-2-Clause; routes from OSM data (ODbL)
sources.notes: A demo server, not meant for production traffic: self-host OSRM (or another engine) with an OSM extract before launch.

sources.name: OpenTopoMap tiles
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 (map style); data OSM (ODbL) and SRTM
sources.attribution: Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, SRTM | Map style: © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA)
sources.notes: A volunteer-run server: check its fair-use terms; self-host for production.

sources.name: Esri World Imagery
sources.use: the satellite base layer (default), its road and place-name label layers (Reference/World_Transportation, Reference/World_Boundaries_and_Places), and the post-ride review map
sources.notes: Check Esri's current terms for use in a commercial app (account or licence may be needed). The label layers' exact credit line (Esri's data providers) must be copied from each service's copyright text before launch.

sources.name: CARTO dark basemap
sources.notes: Check CARTO's current limits for free vs commercial use.

sources.name: Open-Meteo weather, air quality and elevation APIs
sources.use: weather on the route, the advice gate's wet-road check, air quality
sources.licence: data CC BY 4.0; API terms: the free API is for non-commercial use
sources.notes: Commercial use needs an Open-Meteo subscription, or self-hosting the open-source Open-Meteo with openly licensed model data (NOAA GFS, ECMWF open data). IMD data needs its own agreement.

sources.name: Google Maps Platform (Places, Maps)
sources.use: the Maps script tag and place lookups (server-side keys)
sources.licence: Google Maps Platform Terms of Service
sources.access_method: paid API with a server-side key
sources.notes: Paid, under Google's terms (no caching or scraping beyond them). RoadPulse data must never be mixed with Google content.

sources.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
sources.access_method: paid API with a server-side key
sources.notes: Optional: the phone's own TTS works without it.

sources.name: ElevenLabs TTS
sources.access_method: paid API with a server-side key

sources.name: Google Gemini API
sources.use: Deep Search answers (optional; never road facts: 'sensors verify, language models talk')
sources.notes: The product direction is to depend on no third-party AI keys: keep optional, plan to remove or self-host.

sources.name: Groq API
sources.notes: Same as Gemini: optional, planned for removal or self-hosting.

sources.name: TomTom Traffic API
sources.access_method: paid API with a server-side key

sources.name: BigDataCloud reverse geocoding
sources.notes: Check whether the free client-side endpoint allows commercial apps.

sources.name: Last.fm API
sources.notes: Check the API terms for commercial use.

sources.name: Front-end libraries and fonts from CDNs (Leaflet, fonts)
sources.use: map library (Leaflet BSD-2-Clause), web fonts (SIL OFL)
sources.licence: per library: Leaflet BSD-2-Clause; fonts SIL OFL 1.1
sources.access_method: CDN at load time (the service worker caches them)
sources.notes: Licences allow commercial use; consider self-hosting for offline-first and privacy (no third-party requests).

sources.name: RoadPulse rider reports and reviews
sources.notes: Contributor terms must grant MapUnite the right to store, show and license the reports (needed before any API sale), and say what is public (spot, direction, kind, severity, day) and what never is (route, identity).
